name.description: Clean display name: no version, no Discord link, no decorative symbols

ip.description: Domain name, without the port. Numeric IP addresses are not accepted

port.description: Only the default Bedrock port is accepted

description.description: Description, in the language given by `lang`

lang.description: ISO 639-1 language code (en, fr, es, pt-BR...)

image.description: https URL of a banner or logo

logo.description: https URL of the server's square logo (art/logos/, filled by scripts/fetch_art.py)

cover.description: https URL of a wide picture of the server (art/covers/, filled by scripts/fetch_art.py)

gallery.description: https URLs of a few more wide pictures of the server (art/gallery/, filled by scripts/fetch_art.py)
